title: Eternal Rage
description: This mod adds features that attempt to enhance the frustration of the game, perfect for anyone who believes Minecraft is "too fun"
body:
**Please note this mod can break worlds, use at your own risk**
 
 This mod adds 
- A highly explosive wood type, with all variants **except shelves** (working on it), Blegwood
- A poisonous ore, Bleghium, which poisons the player with dizziness and nausea, when touched, all all its tool and armor variants.
- A dangerous liquid, gasoline, which damages the player when touched.
- A Bleghlands biome
- A Bleghwood Cottage structure, which can be found in the Bleghlands biome
- A Bleghwood tree, which can be grown from a Bleghwood sapling
- A Gray Bear which also spawns in the Bleghlands biome
- A potion effect, Bleghium Sickness, which causes the player to take extra damage when hurt, and slightly affects the player's movement
- A Bleghium apple, which grants the player Absobrtion, Regeneration, and Health Boost when eaten
- A Blegh Grass and Blegh Soil blocks, which act the same as regular grass and dirt, but have a gray tone
